subject: Request: one-off sandbox bridge + usage credit beyond PLG limits
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.example.com>
To: Sara Olson <sara@olson.ai>, procurement@olson.ai
Cc: Ben Lyons <ben@olson.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-off sandbox bridge + usage credit beyond PLG limits

Hi Sara / procurement team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — the eval ran cleanly and your ML integrators were able to get 4 production-level prompts working end-to-end. The team hit a hard stop on token usage yesterday (our PLG sandbox is capped at 50k tokens / 14 days), and you asked whether we could bridge the remainder of the engineering work without requiring an immediate contract.

To keep momentum and validate the model quality against your larger dataset, we're proposing a one-time sandbox bridge: a 30-day extension and 150k complimentary tokens (models: rwd-small / rwd-medium) so your integrators can finish the deployment smoke tests. We consider this an exception to standard PLG limits and require deal desk approval.

Attached: sandbox_usage_summary.csv (daily token burn and example traces).

If this looks reasonable, please confirm acceptance of the temporary addendum (I can send a DocuSign). If you intend to convert to a committed pilot within 30 days, we can pair the bridge with a 10% committed usage discount on first 3 months — we can outline that in the addendum.

Next steps we need from Olson: a single procurement point of contact to accept the addendum and confirmation you'd like the discount carve-out.

Best,
Camila
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.example.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Redwood Inference — Production-first inference platform

--
Attachment: sandbox_usage_summary.csv (csv, 34KB)

From: Sara Olson <sara@olson.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-off sandbox bridge + usage credit beyond PLG limits

Camila — thanks for the clear ask and for the attachment. Our engineers confirm the traces look good and the 150k token ask would cover the remaining validation work. Procurement will need:

- A short business justification to present to finance (cost avoidance + go-to-market timing)
- A clear end date and rollback plan for the sandbox extension
- Confirmation that this is a one-time exception tied to an active conversion window

I'm looping procurement@olson.ai here (they asked for the justification language and any contract addendum). Can you provide the short justification and a draft addendum? Also copying Ben (our engineering lead) to keep him posted.

Thanks,
Sara
Head of Data Products, Olson Analytics

To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>

Date: Fri, 07 Aug 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: one-off sandbox bridge + usage credit beyond PLG limits — need one-off approval

Team — escalating for deal-desk / exec signoff. Olson is a mid-market prospect with strong POC results; engineering is blocked on token caps. They want a 30-day extension + 150k complementary tokens. If we approve, we will send the addendum via DocuSign and require:

- A conversion window: Olson must present a signed committed pilot or enterprise MSA within 30 days of the extension end, otherwise credits are rescinded.
- Marketing/reference: Olson agrees to a brief case study or reference call if they convert within 90 days (this helps offset the one-off).

Proposed risk-limited alternative (if full 150k is too large): approve 100k tokens now and hold the remaining 50k pending exec review in 10 days after seeing burn rate and progress. Also propose attaching a minor refundable security hold on billing card for the addendum to prevent abuse.

Why: Olson is high-propensity (data platform + strong analytics team) and the recent benchmarks show model artifacts that map directly to customer value. We expect a closed-won within 90 days with the 10% SEP discount previously discussed.

Attachments: pilot_terms_draft.pdf (proposed addendum text).

Please reply with APPROVE / DENY / COUNTER and any edits to the proposed conditions. I need a decision to communicate to procurement and Sara by Monday EOD.

Thanks,
Camila

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.example.com>, Sara Olson <sara@olson.ai>, procurement@olson.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: one-off sandbox bridge + usage credit beyond PLG limits — need one-off approval

Camila / team — thanks for the clear rationale. I will approve a constrained exception with the following binding conditions:

1) Approve 100,000 complimentary tokens for a 30-day sandbox extension (models: rwd-small / rwd-medium).
2) Remaining 50,000 tokens will be held in reserve and can be released only after a 10-day operational check-in demonstrating actual progress (engineering notes + burn traces).
3) Olson must sign the pilot addendum via DocuSign within 48 hours of receiving it; the addendum will include a 30-day conversion commitment or credits are reclaimed.
4) Marissa (finance) to confirm that the one-off is booked to Q3 discretionary credits and that procurement contact is validated.
5) Marketing/reference clause is required if the deal converts within 90 days.

Marissa — please confirm finance booking and whether we should require a nominal refundable hold (e.g., $1,000) on Olson's card as a guardrail.

Camila — once Marissa confirms, send DocuSign and I'll notify Sara. Good catch on the conversion window.

Jordan Blake
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

Confirming finance. We will classify this as a Q3 discretionary pilot credit (GL code: RED-PILOT-CR). Approving Jordan's recommendation (100k now, 50k reserved).

Regarding the refundable hold: Finance recommends a nominal $1,000 refundable authorization if Olson can provide a card on file; if procurement refuses, we can instead require a signed PO referencing the pilot addendum. Either approach is acceptable.

Camila — once you send the DocuSign addendum, include an accounting contact (acct-receivable@olson.ai or PO number) so we can log the credit and hold the reversal conditions.

Marissa Cole
